# FLX-7011: promotion policy document is malformed

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A promotion-policy document must declare policy_id (a non-empty string) and, when present, grade_ceiling as a mapping from a ClaimBasis value to one of the six FLUX letter grades. A malformed policy is refused rather than loaded with a field silently defaulted, because a promotion decision an owner did not actually author is not one this engine will honour.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7011
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
